capability_summary: Fiber-optic KVM matrix switching, signal extension and secure video distribution for multi-classification command-and-control facilities. A Belden subsidiary and a hardware OEM: federal revenue reaches the government through GSA-schedule integrators and value-added resellers, not through Thinklogical as a prime.

The approved 2026-07-06 packet is NOT edited: revise() refuses an approved strategy and re-approval is an operator gate.
